sample_unit: surgical cases (temporal test set, 2024 ACS NSQIP)
models_evaluated: three pretrained clinical text-encoder embedding classifiers

links.outcome: AUROC of complex ML models versus logistic regression and NSQIP Surgical Risk Calculator on identical cases
links.effect: FT-Transformer exceeded logistic regression by only 0.009–0.030 AUROC; calculator matched best model for mortality but trailed for any complication.
links.quote: The FT-Transformer led or tied on AUROC for all four outcomes (0.755–0.955), exceeding logistic regression by only 0.009–0.030; the three encoders fell 0.005–0.009 short of the best tabular model and spanned 0.003 or less.

links.outcome: Model ranking consistency between national test data and a single-institution deployment check
links.effect: Rankings changed under AUPRC and did not hold in a 3,490-case single-institution deployment check.
links.quote: Rankings changed under AUPRC and did not hold in a 3,490-case single-institution deployment check, not independent of the PUF.

unlisted_practices: Comparing architecture and text-encoder choice for tabular perioperative risk prediction with fixed predictor set

screen.reason: Evaluates machine learning models for perioperative risk and tests how model rankings change during a local single-institution evaluation check compared to national benchmarks.
